duplicates.definition: same symbol + thesis side + engine + instrument (option strike/type/expiry, else asset class); a later idea counts as a duplicate when an earlier one in the group was still open at its publish time, or it was published the same or next ET day

anyStrike.definition: same symbol + thesis side + engine, any strike/expiry/asset, overlapping or same/next ET day
